pairs.subject: settings
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/billing/autorecharge/route.ts:110 The context's one stored setting is the per-org low-balance preference (rendered and saved from CreditsControl). Its change record carries only the new value, written even on no-op saves. Its legacy audit-row fallback has no reaper. A malformed or unreadable column falls through to the stale legacy row instead of stopping, and closing the popover silently discards an unsaved edit.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/billing/autorecharge/route.ts:110 Records key, new value, actor and time, best-effort relative to the write (correct). But there is no old value, so revert is impossible, and an identical re-save is not detected, so no-ops pollute the trail.

src/lib/db/org-settings.ts:104 The storage was relocated (audit row -> autoRechargeJson column) without a migration and with no named reaper. Orgs that never re-save stay on the legacy read forever, and an audit purge can still silently revert their threshold.

src/lib/db/org-settings.ts:120 Declared order column -> legacy audit -> default, with provenance (source) recorded (good). But a failed column read is swallowed to null and the resolver falls past it to the legacy audit row, contradicting the line-111 claim that any read failure degrades to the default.

src/lib/db/org-settings.ts:122 `stored` is the PARSE result, so a present-but-unusable column loses to the deprecated audit-row source. Precedence is decided on value, not presence, and there is no deprecation notice or release-named retirement of the old source.

src/lib/db/org-settings.ts:145 Strong single door: getOrgAutoRecharge plus normalizeAutoRecharge clamp on read, the write door 400s an out-of-range threshold, and the default is declared with rationale. But the parse-failure branch reports nothing (no telemetry) and treats corruption as unset.

src/components/shared/credits/useCreditsControl.ts:54 An explicit Save button and adoption of the server's echoed value (no optimistic flip), plus an aria-live error, are conformant (CreditsControl.tsx:189 re-seeds the draft from stored). But an outside click or Escape closes the popover and unmounts a dirty draft without any unsaved-changes guard.

src/app/api/org/credits/grant/route.ts:39 The mint ceiling fails closed and cannot be raised from env. creditGrantsEnabled is a flag that defaults off with a production floor. The low-balance preference defaults off and is owner-gated. Per-kind fail directions match the table, though kinds are not declared in a registry.
src/components/shared/credits/CreditsControl.autorechargeUi.tsx:23 A single key is fetched lazily on popover open, so there is no boot-time fan-out to batch.
src/lib/autorecharge.ts:63 The threshold default is a code constant (aligned by copy with another constant), not a live upstream source the org follows.
src/lib/autorecharge.ts:80 One constant default object, not a shipped collection of user-editable default entries.
src/lib/db/org-settings.ts:9 The value is held in the server DB row, not an operator-owned file with no other copy.

src/lib/db/org-settings.ts:142 The blob is one key's 3-field structured value, not the whole settings space as one document. Note that normalize-then-stringify drops unknown members a newer build might add.
